items.title: Private life, public disclosure: Nvidia’s CEO crisis in Indian securities law
items.summary: On November 12, 2026, Nvidia Corporation announced that its co-founder Jensen Huang had resigned as President, CEO and director with immediate effect. Its Form 8-K , the “current report” a US-listed company must file with the SEC to announce major events, shows that the board had accepted the resignation a day earlier. Neither document gives a reason. Four days earlier, the board had opened an independent investigation “in light of recent reporting” that Huang had been “the target of a foreign intelligence effort”. The same day, Nvidia published his email to employees admitting that he had been unfaithful to his wife. A denial, an admission, an inquiry and a resignation. The question for an Indian securities lawyer is: what if this had been a company listed on the Indian stock exchanges? The short answer is that Indian law would have demanded faster and fuller disclosure. It would have done little for the investor. Throughout, the test is not what the CEO did in private, but what the market was told about it and when. items.title: TVS family dispute: What the law says about a daughter’s inheritance rights
items.summary: The dispute within the TVS family over the distribution of its assets among the next generation took a legal turn on Monday, with Dr Lakshmi Venu sending a notice to her father and TVS Holdings Chairman Venu Srinivasan. Through the legal notice, Lakshmi has called for a “fair and lawful partition” of the assets of the Venu Srinivasan branch of the Chennai-based TVS family, and contends that “the concentration of beneficial interest in favour of her (younger) brother,” Sudarshan Venu, was to the exclusion of her own lawful rights. Lakshmi is the MD of auto parts maker Sundaram-Clayton, with a market cap of over Rs 2,000 crore, while Sudarshan is the chairman and MD of two-wheeler maker TVS Motors, which has a market cap of over Rs 2 lakh crore. Sudarshan is also MD of TVS Holdings, the holding company, which is headed by their father, Venu. Venu’s wife, Mallika Srinivasan, is the chairperson and MD of tractor manufacturer TAFE, where Lakshmi is vice-chair. In April last year, Venu named his son and current CMD of TVS Motor, Sudarshan, as the Significant Beneficial Owner.
